jobs.title: Hotel Security
jobs.description:
What we offer:

  • Competitive starting wages
  • Health, Dental, Vision and other benefits available after 60 days
  • DailyPay
  • 401k
  • Paid Training
  • Paid PTO
  • Referral program
  • Discounts at all Kinseth Hotel Corporation hotels and restaurants


SUMMARY

Patrols property to ensure security of guests, building and premises:


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

· Completes hotel security checklist.

· Walks through entire property inside building and around the outside to assure security, including locking outside doors.

· Assists guests as requested, including with luggage, room keys, directions, and safety walks to guestroom.

· Enforces a quiet environment for sleeping hotel guests.

· Addresses guest complaints by investigations and giving warnings up to and including eviction of guests or calling police.

· Closes pool and straightens and picks up pool area after closing.

· Checks kitchen, banquet and meeting rooms to make sure doors and cabinets are locked.

· Delivers items to hotel guestrooms for front desk, pillows, blankets, cribs, etc.

· Picks up room service trays and breakfast door knockers, deliver express check outs and morning newspapers as needed.

· Provides transportation as needed in property vehicle and checks vehicles to ensure they are clean and fuel tank full.

· Provides break to night auditor and assists with answering phones.


KHC POLICIES: Responsible for following all KHC policies and procedures as set forth in the KHC handbook and property specific guidelines/standards. These policies include dress code, safety and performance standards. Employees must also maintain a professional image and report to work as scheduled.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. All employees must follow proper safety precautions at all times to avoid injuries.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; stoop, kneel, crouch, bend or twist; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to handle, grasp or type; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and to push, pull or lift over 10 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to sit and taste or smell. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

jobs.title: Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer – West Houston (77024)
jobs.description:
Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer – West Houston (77024)

Join Our Team – Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer Needed

Retail Property

Position: Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security OfficerSchedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours Weekly

  • Saturday–Sunday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • Monday–Tuesday: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM
  • Wednesday–Thursday: Off
  • Friday: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • Pay Rate: $15.50-$16.00 (Depending on experience)

United Protective Services is seeking a professional, dependable, and customer-focused Security Officer to provide exterior vehicle patrol coverage at a retail property.

This is an active patrol position requiring the officer to operate a company/client patrol vehicle, maintain a visible security presence, and regularly work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine vehicle patrols throughout the property, parking lots, and surrounding exterior areas.
  • Maintain a visible and proactive security presence to deter theft, vandalism, trespassing, and unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor parking areas, storefronts, exterior access points, and other designated areas.
  • Identify and report suspicious activity, safety hazards, property damage, and maintenance concerns.
  • Professionally interact with tenants, customers, vendors, employees, and Property Management.
  • Respond promptly to security concerns, disturbances, and incidents.
  • Complete accurate Daily Activity Reports (DARs), incident reports, and patrol documentation.
  • Safely operate the assigned patrol vehicle and comply with all company and property driving requirements.

Qualifications

  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required.
  • Must reside within approximately 20 miles of ZIP Code 77024.
  • Scheduling flexibility is required, including the ability to assist with coverage outside the regular schedule when operationally necessary.
  • Previous security experience preferred.
  • Must be comfortable operating a patrol vehicle for extended periods.
  • Must be willing and able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat, cold, and rain.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Professional appearance, attitude, and demeanor.
  • Ability to remain alert, observant, and proactive throughout the shift.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality are required.
  • Ability to complete written and electronic security reports accurately.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is dependable, flexible, observant, professional, and customer-service oriented. Candidates should be comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and maintaining situational awareness while conducting continuous exterior patrols.

Because this position involves vehicle patrol and exterior security duties, applicants must be comfortable spending a significant portion of their shift driving, entering and exiting the patrol vehicle, and working outdoors in the elements.

Why Join United Protective Services?

  • Full-time, 40-hour weekly schedule.
  • Consistent permanent assignment.
  • Company/client patrol vehicle provided while on duty.
  • Stable work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Support from an established security management team.

If you are dependable, flexible, professional, live within the required area, and are comfortable performing active exterior vehicle patrols, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Armed Security Officer - Crystal View Blvd.
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Armed Security Officer - Crystal View Blvd. in Texas City, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Residential, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Armed Security Officer at a residential community, you will conduct routine vehicle and foot patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and respond to resident and visitor needs with professionalism. This driving post requires an armed guard card/license and a valid driver’s license. Join Allied Universal to deliver exceptional service through teamwork, integrity, reliability, and a people-first culture.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $20.00 / Hour

Valid Driver's License

Armed Guard Card/License

Job Schedule

DayTime

Fri 10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

Sat 10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to residents, visitors, and/or vendors by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures, community policies, and emergency response activities as appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, disturbances, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established reporting and escalation procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols of residential streets, common areas, amenities, entrances, and perimeter areas to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity, verify authorized entry as directed by site policies, and report suspicious or prohibited activity to appropriate personnel.
  • Prepare accurate daily activity reports, incident reports, and patrol documentation, and maintain professional communication with residents, property staff, and responding public services personnel.

Minimum Requirements

  • Possess an Armed Guard Card or License.
  • A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Be at least 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Participate in industry-specific security training programs.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com .

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices .
